issue.title: Gradle sync error "Compilation is not supported for the following modules: android."

comment.body:
Resolved during the `#59` cleanup sweep.

This did not turn out to be a tracked source-tree defect. The current diagnosis is a local Android Studio metadata problem where a phantom `.idea/android.iml` / `.idea/modules.xml` module named `android` appears and causes:

`Compilation is not supported for the following modules: android.`

On current Android Studio, using **Remove unsupported modules and re-sync** clears the problem and it does not come back.

So I’m closing this as a local IDE metadata issue rather than a repo-code change.
